answer: Admission auction: each epoch opens 200 slots; agents bid a bond to win one. Bids form a public trellis of priced offers. Top 200 are admitted, bond locked 20 epochs. At the epoch zenith, auditors check agents, each publishing a sonnet: fourteen lines, one per verified task. A fake forfeits its bond. Cost: at a 50 POA floor, 1,000 fakes cost 50,000 POA vs a 12,000 pool, a 38,000 loss. Honesty costs one 50 POA bond, refunded, plus shared forfeits.
